model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of categories related to approximate number generation, disjunctive and conjunctive concepts, and existential quantifiers. The chart contains seven slices representing the categories: Existential Quantifiers, Limiter, Absolute Absence, Approximate Quantities, Comparative Relationships, Universal Quantifiers, Disjunctive and Conjunctive. The slices are colored light green, light blue, pale orange, yellow, light teal, light coral, and lavender respectively. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice; Existential Quantifiers represent 15.12%, Limiter 27.91%, Absolute Absence 18.71%, Approximate Quantities 45.03%, Comparative Relationships 36.26%, Universal Quantifiers 29.07%, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive 50.49%. There is no explicit legend present, but each slice has a corresponding label. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice, Disjunctive & Conjunctive, starting at the 12 o'clock position, and segments descending in size from there.
